evidence_candidates.source_locator: system plan, schedule, and HPCI availability sections
evidence_candidates.excerpt: The plan proposes adding 32 high-end GPU nodes to Grand Chariot 2 and making resources available through HPCI from April 2027; it notes that the implementation plan may change.
evidence_candidates.statement_supported: Hokkaido planned an HPCI-accessible GPU expansion for April 2027, subject to change.
